name: Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis

locations.note: Indy's search starts at a New York theater where psychic Sophia Hapgood lectures on Atlantis.
The Minoan ruins of Knossos on Crete hold the labyrinth that points toward Atlantis.
In Monte Carlo Indy seeks out collector Alain Trottier for clues to the lost city.
At an excavation in Iceland Indy finds Dr Heimdall frozen beside an Atlantean eel figurine, and his notes on Costa and Sternhart.
Indy searches the Algiers souk for clues to Atlantis.
A small Atlantean colony on Thera provides the route to Atlantis.
Through an underwater entrance near Thera Indy explores the sunken city, frees Sophia from the spirit of King Nur-Ab-Sal and reaches the colossus the Atlanteans built to make themselves gods.
On the Team path Indy and Sophia find Dr Sternhart's temple in the jungle at Tikal, with an Atlantean relic inside.
Indy calls on the retired sea captain Costa in the Azores, who has one of the Lost Dialogue's clues.

routes.name: Indy's journey (Team path)
routes.note: Indy and Sophia's hunt for Atlantis, from her New York lecture to the sunken city near Thera.
